sections.heading: Honoring Susan’s legacy
sections.html: Susan believed every child deserves the chance to grow through Play, Nature, and the Arts — her vision was a world where children are free to imagine, explore, and connect. Your gift fuels Sunflower’s joyful model of education — supporting every child, honoring Susan’s legacy, and building a strong future together.

image.alt: Children playing and creating together at Sunflower Creative Arts

sections.html: “If you can imagine a better world, you can make a better world.”

sections.heading: Did you know Sunflower is a nonprofit?
sections.html:
Sunflower Creative Arts is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering children and families through Play, Nature, and the Arts.

Tuition and program fees do not cover the full cost of operating Sunflower programs. Each year, fundraising bridges the gap and helps sustain the creative, nurturing, play-based learning environments our children enjoy.
